digest.component_or_area: review kernel and consumer pipelines (plan-review, code-review)
propositions: plan_review_decide emits and drains contract violations via a ContextVar sink, but code_review_decide only logs errors and lacks the equivalent sink/coverage integration

outcome_counts tally (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) is generated inside verify_findings() during chunk processing but cannot be reconstructed at the *_decide boundary after workflow engine merges per-chunk outputs
contract-violation sink implementation is duplicated between plan-review and code-review pipelines instead of being a shared review_kernel utility
code_review verdict coverage lacks outcome_counts and verification_contract_violations telemetry fields present in plan-review coverage
outcome_counts at *_decide boundary should be a single-run tally derived from merged verifications and reshape state, with unrecoverable always 0 due to workflow engine retry layer
